title: Changing texture_origin in Tile Set Editor breaks Terrain Set Paint tool
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.0.4.stable, 4.4.stable, 4.5.dev[215acd52e]

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (215acd52e) - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7283) - AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads)

### Issue description

Trying to paint on tiles that have a Texture Origin set shifts the preview and paint region in the Terrain Set Paint Editor.

this makes it impossible to properly make terrain set's with the tool unless first clearly the Texture Origin and applying the origin afterwards again once done with the Terrain Set.

Painting the bits still works for the visible ones but some are behind other tiles making it impossible for them to be set.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b3043a6-cde5-4723-ab6b-c7c3e756bd75


### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new Tile Set
- Add a new Terrain Set
- Adjust the Texture Origin of a Tile
- Open the Terrain Set Editor in the Paint tool
- Select the Terrain Set
- See that the drawing doesn't work properly on the Tile with the Texture Origin Adjusted

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

a simple project with a tile set setup and 2 tiles with a Texture Origin adjusted
[tileset-bug-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19721590/tileset-bug-test.zip)
